A country average does not define you. Your Innerly report comes only from your answers.

A few things to know.

Is this a diagnosis or a fixed personality type?

No. It is a self-reflection exercise across five continuous dimensions, not a clinically validated assessment. It does not diagnose depression, predict career success or determine relationship compatibility. Scores describe your answers, not your worth.

Can I take my time and change an answer?

Yes. Five questions appear together, and completed groups advance automatically. Your answers save in this browser, so you can pause, return and revise. Use A+ in the header for larger text.

Do I need to pay or share my email?

Your summary and full report are free for now. No account or email is required. Answers and reports stay on this device, in this browser.
